extracted.name: Chuck's Favorite Mac and Cheese
extracted.description: This mac and cheese with cottage cheese, shredded Cheddar, and grated Parmesan is topped with a buttery breaded topping. It's super cheesy and delicious!
ingredient_lines: 1 (12 ounce) container small curd cottage cheese
1 (8 ounce) package shredded sharp Cheddar cheese
instruction_lines: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C). Grease a 9x13-inch baking dish.
Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Cook elbow macaroni in the boiling water, stirring occasionally, until tender yet firm to the bite, about 8 minutes. Drain.
Mix bread crumbs and melted butter together in a small bowl.
Transfer drained macaroni to the prepared baking dish. Add cottage cheese, Cheddar, sour cream, Parmesan, salt, and pepper; stir until well combined. Sprinkle bread crumb mixture over top.
Bake in the preheated oven until golden brown on top, 30 to 35 minutes.
